instruction: Each file in in/services/ (billing.conf, search.conf, gateway.conf, mailer.conf) holds key=value lines including name=<service>, listen=<host>:<port> and optionally admin=<host>:<port>. Ports are compared by number regardless of host. Write out/port_map.csv with header port,users and one row per port in ascending numeric order, where users is the space-separated list of '<name>.<key>' entries (key is listen or admin) using that port, sorted byte-wise ascending. Write out/conflicts.txt with one line 'CONFLICT <port>: <user>, <user>' (same sorted users, joined by ', ') for every port used more than once, in ascending port order, or the single line NO CONFLICTS.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
